name: NER (LLM, configurable types)

prompt_template.description: Extract biomedical named entities from text
prompt_template.system:
You are a biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) expert. 
Extract all entities of the specified types from the given text.
Return ONLY a valid JSON object with entity types as keys and lists of extracted entities as values.
Do not include any explanation or markdown formatting.

description: Extract entities for configurable types via {labels} or default entity_types in metadata.
